plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid cell opposite its current orientation without rotating it, while preserving existing boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to the MovementOrder enum.
Add an opposite-direction operation to Direction so reverse displacement can reuse Position.move without changing vehicle orientation.
Handle REVERSE in MovementEngine.applyOrder by moving one cell opposite the vehicle's orientation and retaining its original orientation.

Keep reverse intentions within the existing board validation and simultaneous collision-resolution pipeline so out-of-bounds movement, occupied targets, competing targets, swaps, and blocked chains behave consistently with forward movement.

Update the game rules to define REVERSE, its movement vectors, orientation behavior, boundary behavior, and participation in collision resolution, and remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Add movement-engine tests showing REVERSE moves one cell opposite each cardinal orientation while preserving orientation.
Add a test showing an out-of-bounds REVERSE order leaves the vehicle unchanged.
Add coverage showing reverse movement obeys collision rules, including collision with a stationary vehicle and conflicts with another moving vehicle.
Run the backend Maven test suite with ./mvnw test from the backend directory.
